cap1.text: Hello? If you're hearing this, you're the new night guard. This is Rulo, from the last shift.
I'm not coming back inside. Neither should you. But you signed the contract, so listen.
The front doors are Chained from the inside. The old night guard kept the spare key in his Hut , the small concrete box by the west fence.
Find the key, get in, and Close the doors behind you. Whatever walks that parking lot at night... it isn't me.
Press F for your flashlight. It never dies. The batteries are the least of your problems tonight.

cap2.text: You made it in. Good. Now listen close, rookie: the whole grid is tripping.

Four stations keep this place alive: the Breaker in the Electrical Room, a portable Generator in the Loading Dock, the Pump in the south-east wing, and the Master Panel in the Generator Room behind the south promenade.
Each one you start will light its zone back up... and Wake something that sleeps in the dark. The noise carries. It always carries.
There's a note with the master fuse order nailed in the Electrical Room. Read it with your own eyes: 3, 1, 4, 2.
Freddy is slow tonight. He won't be tomorrow. Crouch with Ctrl, stay quiet, and don't shine your light at him for too long.

cap3.text: Still alive? Good. In the Security Office I left a tablet with the cameras. Take it , you'll see them coming.
Grab Two spare fuses: one in Parts & Service, one in North Storage. The machines drink power like a beast.
Then collect 3 Golden Tokens. One by the arcade booths, one behind the bowling lanes, one deep in the West Storage annex. They're not all lying in plain sight.
The bowling alley has three fried pinsetters. And the Food Court... she's been hunting those tables since midnight. Restart everything.
Bonnie comes out of the vents, Chica out of the kitchen. Your flashlight freezes Bonnie; Chica hears Everything. Crouch. Walk. Survive.
When the machines sing again, check the Prize Counter. Something left a gift there.

cap4.text: Bad news, rookie. The Technical Gallery just died. Six service doors, and only One way to know what's behind them: Sound.
A Fan hums where nobody is. Pots And Pans clang where she is tearing the kitchen apart. Heavy steps or a metallic laugh... Not that door. Don't open it. Ever.
When the gallery is done, Get Back TO The Office and don't leave. They know where you sleep.
Watch the cameras. The Music Box in the Prize Counter runs down if you look away too long , keep it wound up, or the thing inside it comes out to play.
Listen at the doors. Real steps come in fours and stop. Fake ones loop like a bad tape. Learn the difference, or you'll open the wrong door.
Survive until the motors cool down. Then we talk about the basement.

cap5.text: Listen. The only real exit left is below: The Basement. What's left of the Original pizzeria, under the north wing.
The fire doors need Three keycards: Rockstar Row, the Theater, and the Food Court. Get them. All of them.
Pirate's Cove hides the first one, and the fox has started to really run. His curtain... the tape is behind the ship. Take it and flip the switches.
It's been burning for Years down there. Racks, crates, spare parts, the old show stage... a graveyard with shelves.
Something with a moon for a face lives in that smoke. It hears Everything. Five fires, Five extinguishers. Kill them all and the emergency route to the service tunnels opens.
Whatever you were before tonight... it ends Here.

cap6.text: You're below the basement now. The Service Tunnels. They wired this place before the mall, and they wired it Wrong.
Three Relays feed the security gate at the end of the east tunnel. There's a maintenance stencil with the order , the shift code: Second, Third, First.
Relay 2, then relay 3, then relay 1. Flip them in that order or the breaker trips and you start over.
Something Broken patrols down there. It hunts by Sound , it can't see well in the pipes, but every step you take is a dinner bell. Crouch. Walk. Listen.

The gate itself won't open without a master keycard. The ones upstairs are toys. The real one is in the Forgotten Archive , the sealed records room off the west tunnel. The relays will unseal its door.
Old Freddy's footsteps still echo from the basement... or it's the pipes. It's always the pipes. Right?

cap7.text: You found it. The Forgotten Archive , maintenance and security records of everything they buried. Read fast, listen faster.
The terminal is dead: start the two Archive Fuses on the north wall to feed it. Loud work. She will hear it.
The recovery logs all mention one year , the year of the second incident. The tapes will tell you which one. That's the vault code.
Inside the vault: the Master Keycard. The only card that opens the security gate. The only way this story ends.
She's hunting the shelves now. The archive has hidespots and hollow racks , use them. Wait for the steps to pass. Then move.
Take the card and get back to the gate. Don't stop for the tapes. Don't stop for anything.

cap8.text: Last call, rookie. Insert the card. Hit the override. The gate lifts Slow , about a minute and a half of screaming metal.
When the alarm starts, HE comes. The golden one. He doesn't patrol, he doesn't search , he just Walks toward you until one of you stops.
You can't outrun him forever. Break line of sight. Duck into the racks. Let the alarm sing for you.
The stairs up to the basement are open. The fire doors are open. The whole mall is a straight line now , tunnels, basement, north wing, all the way out.
Hold the gate side until it lifts. Then Run and don't look back. See you on the other side... if there is one.
